cases.title: Vehicle Definition versus owned Campaign instance
cases.source_coordinate: PPIA-04 taxonomy / vehicle-definition + owned-vehicle-asset-instance; Vehicles.csv governed Vehicle domain
governed_facts: Definition identity/version and intrinsic mechanics remain separate from Campaign ownership, crew, Resources, damage, and Scene position.
An owned vehicle instance snapshots/references its Definition without rewriting source content.
acceptance: Opening a Definition never shows fabricated current fuel, crew, damage, or position.
Editing an authorized instance never mutates the reusable Definition.

cases.title: Source-backed variant/configuration remains distinct from instance
cases.source_coordinate: PPIA-04 taxonomy / definition-configuration-variant; retained spacecraft class source library
governed_facts: Variant/class/configuration is a reusable layer separate from a live owned vehicle.
Conflicting or alternative source versions remain distinguishable until governed resolution.
acceptance: Compare exposes variant/version/conflict labels without merging identities.
Selecting a configuration does not create ownership or live runtime state.

cases.title: Explicit mecha component parent/compatibility evidence
cases.source_coordinate: CSV_VEHICLE_PARENT_RECONCILIATION_CONTRACT.json; Mecha.csv governed component families
governed_facts: Deterministic parent links require explicit parent evidence.
Component Definition and installed relation are separate.
acceptance: Install preview cites compatibility evidence and does not rewrite component identity.
Successful installation records slot/hardpoint and readiness separately from ownership.

cases.title: Unresolved component relationship blocks name-similarity auto-link
cases.source_coordinate: CSV_VEHICLE_PARENT_RECONCILIATION_CONTRACT.json; PPIA-04 source inventory
governed_facts: Name similarity and source-document grouping are candidate evidence only.
acceptance: Ambiguous parent/compatibility remains unresolved.
UI cannot silently install, bind, or promote a component because names look related.

cases.title: Owner is not automatically the pilot/driver
cases.source_coordinate: MV-IA-F014 authority/station model; PPIA-04 authority-relations
governed_facts: Ownership, custody, control, and station authority are independent.
Pilot/driver authority is explicit.
acceptance: Owner without pilot station sees no pilot controls.
Assigned pilot receives only authorized station controls and does not become owner.

cases.title: Conflicting crew commands resolve by declared command policy
cases.source_coordinate: MV-IA-F014 crew/station command policy contract
fixture_requirements: two authorized station holders submit incompatible governed commands against the same expected version
acceptance: UI arrival order is not authoritative.
Rejected/stale command returns role-safe current state without leaking hidden stations.

cases.title: Hidden occupants and cargo do not leak through totals
cases.source_coordinate: MV-IA-F020/F021 permission filtering; PPIA-04 cargo/crew privacy invariants
fixture_requirements: viewer may see vehicle but not one occupant, one container, or one carried craft
acceptance: Visible roster/count/capacity/search facets are computed only after filtering.
No placeholder count, used-capacity delta, export row, diagnostic, notification, or AI summary reveals hidden existence.

cases.title: Carrier/hangar carried craft remains a separate Asset relation
cases.source_coordinate: Carrier Class.PDF + Mecha Hangars v2.PDF retained source anchors; PPIA-04 cargo/carried-craft layer
governed_facts: Carried/attached craft relationship does not collapse identities.
Deployment/launch changes relationship/placement state rather than cloning the craft.
acceptance: Carrier and carried craft retain separate IDs/provenance.
Launch removes/changes carried relation exactly once and creates no duplicate Asset.

cases.title: Semantic movement works without map pointing
cases.source_coordinate: MV-IA-F013 semantic positioning + MV-IA-F014 vehicle movement
governed_facts: Zone/anchor, range, adjacency, facing, altitude/depth, velocity, and environment constraints are semantic rule state.
Canvas pixels are presentation unless rules-bound.
acceptance: Keyboard/screen-reader user can choose valid semantic destination and movement command from labelled controls.
Dragging a token or drawing a path is never required to establish authoritative movement.

cases.title: Operational attack/scan command commits outcome and Resource cost atomically
cases.source_coordinate: MV-IA-F007 Action pipeline + MV-IA-F014 vehicle Actions/Resources
acceptance: Proposal/approval/result follows shared Action model.
Outcome and Resource spend either both commit or neither commits.
Unauthorized errors do not reveal hidden systems/capabilities.

cases.title: Source-unspecified vehicle Resource/capacity stays unknown
cases.source_coordinate: PPIA-04 taxonomy resources-power-fuel-heat; PPIA-04 source guardrails
governed_facts: Unknown/source-unspecified is distinct from zero, empty, full, unlimited, unavailable, or compatible.
acceptance: UI displays unknown/source-unspecified state explicitly.
Validator/action preconditions stop or route to governed resolution rather than inventing a capacity or Resource value.

cases.title: Subsystem damage does not erase vehicle Asset identity
cases.source_coordinate: MV-IA-F014 damage/failure surfaces; PPIA-04 damage-condition-failure layer
governed_facts: Hull/frame, motive, power, sensor, weapon/system, station, cargo/passenger, and environmental-seal failure are distinct governed surfaces.
Destroyed/disabled consequences are profile-bound.
acceptance: Damage can disable systems/vehicle without rewriting Definition or ownership lineage.
Zero hull/frame does not universally delete provenance/history.

cases.title: Repair and maintenance append history without rewriting source facts
cases.source_coordinate: PPIA-04 provenance-history-recovery + resources-power-fuel-heat
governed_facts: Repair/maintenance changes instance/runtime state and appends service history.
Source Definition remains unchanged.
acceptance: Before/after damage/resource state is traceable.
Repeated ambiguous repair command cannot double-consume parts/Resources or duplicate history entry.

cases.title: Docking, boarding and launch use explicit semantic relations
cases.source_coordinate: MV-IA-F014 docking/boarding/launch; MV-IA-F013 semantic relations
governed_facts: Docked, boarded, carried/attached, interior/exterior, and launched states are explicit relations.
Visual overlap alone is not docking.
acceptance: Command validates semantic adjacency/relation and authority before commit.
Boarding/launch updates relationships atomically and preserves both vehicle identities.

cases.title: Capture/salvage separates custody/control from ownership lineage
cases.source_coordinate: PPIA-04 authority-relations + provenance/history contracts
fixture_requirements: vehicle changes custody/control after governed capture outcome
acceptance: Capture does not silently erase prior owner/provenance.
Salvage/transfer produces explicit governed ownership/custody deltas and history.

cases.title: Hidden installed system does not leak through capability/readiness summaries
cases.source_coordinate: MV-IA-F020/F021 + PPIA-04 installed-configuration privacy rule
fixture_requirements: viewer can see vehicle and some systems but not one installed system
acceptance: System count, hardpoint summary, readiness, capability tags, action menus, comparison, export, diagnostics, and AI context exclude the hidden system.
Failed action cannot reveal its existence.

cases.title: Ambiguous network vehicle command resolves by operation-status lookup
cases.source_coordinate: MV-IA-F021 recovery + PPIA-04 provenance/recovery invariants
fixture_requirements: client loses response after submitting an idempotent mutation
acceptance: Client queries operation ID/status before retry.
Retry reuses idempotency identity and cannot duplicate movement, attack, Resource spend, damage, docking, launch, or transfer.

cases.title: Station authority revocation immediately removes protected controls
cases.source_coordinate: PPIA-04 permission invariants / authority revocation
fixture_requirements: player has an open station view when control grant is revoked
acceptance: Protected controls disappear/disable on current role-safe state.
Protected caches and prefetched hidden system/route data are invalidated.

cases.title: Accessible nonvisual full vehicle operation
cases.source_coordinate: MV-IA-F014 accessible list/table/station-roster/system-detail alternatives; PPIA-04 accessibility contract
fixture_requirements: screen-reader and keyboard-only operator completes station selection, semantic movement, system Action, Resource review, damage review, and docking flow
acceptance: No required step depends on drag, hover, color, animation, spatial canvas, or pointer precision.
State changes, validation, and authoritative results are announced with labels/units/semantic relations.

cases.title: Deferred simulation feature remains opaque/non-operational
cases.source_coordinate: IA-D08-003 advanced map/vehicle deferral package; PPIA-04 explicitly_deferred_capabilities
governed_facts: Detailed power-grid routing, continuous Newtonian/orbital simulation, full synchronized interiors, autonomous drones/programmable vehicle AI, and other listed deferrals are not bounded Internal Alpha/PPIA-04 operational features.
acceptance: Unknown/versioned extension data may be preserved without pretending to simulate it.
UI/validator never marks a deferred processor/circuit/orbit/interior feature as operational merely because data is present.
